contexts.text: To commit adultery... also means to do obscene things... TCR 313.
They who in the life of the body have accustomed themselves to speak filthy and obscene things, retain the like things in the other life. Explained.
a. A very obscene girl. SE 3895.
Other obscene Spirits who thus inhered in them...
That more obscene things come forth from the lands where Christians are, than formerly. Explained.
When left to themselves they were carried away into very obscene things...
